widths_note: half-widths in log-nu units (full range is ln 10 = 2.30). MLP seed-0 val neural-only error: median 8%, p90 33% (|log err| ~0.08 / ~0.29). Width selected on VALIDATION only, by lowest mean CPU-s per query (mean drives break-even).
